sessions.t: Automate your AWS partnership with a unified agentic operating model
sessions.a: Getting the most from your AWS partnership requires thoughtful and sustained engagement from both sides. Instead of heavy manual lifts, an agentic partner operating model supports this engagement at scale through strategic automation, delivering the right guidance, insight, and capabilities to team members who need them most. In this workshop, build a unified agentic operating model that connects pipeline, co-sell coordination, and AWS consumption measurement into a single orchestration layer using your CRM, AWS Partner Central, and Amazon Quick, enabling all team members to easily leverage AWS tools, insights, and investments from one agentic surface to increase your AWS engagement.

sessions.t: Automate your business processes with workflow agents on AgentCore
sessions.a: The agents with the clearest ROI don't wait for a prompt. They wake on an event and run a process to completion. A new lead triggers a prospecting agent, a filed ticket triggers IT resolution, a spend threshold triggers a campaign adjustment. This session covers best practices for building workflow agents on AgentCore: triggering agents from event sources, running long tasks asynchronously on Runtime, connecting to systems of record through gateway, holding state with memory, adding human-in-the-loop approvals, and enforcing actions with policies the agent cannot bypass.

sessions.t: Automate your landing zone and network migration with AWS Transform
sessions.a: Designing landing zones and translating on-premises networks into cloud-native architectures is complex and time-consuming. AWS Transform automates both. In this workshop, you'll see the landing zone agent analyze your requirements and deploy AWS Control Tower, organizational units, service control policies, and workload accounts as infrastructure as code. Then the network agent translates VMware networking components or firewall configurations into VPCs, subnets, security groups, and transit gateways with hub-and-spoke or isolated topologies, ready for deployment in CDK or Terraform modules. Laptop required.

sessions.t: Automating data pipelines with agentic AI and Apache Iceberg
sessions.a: Join this session to experience the magic of agentic AI and Apache Iceberg coming together on AWS to build a self-correcting data pipeline. We will dive in to an agentic architecture for an Iceberg-based data pipeline where critical telemetry signals such as data loss, schema drift, cost spikes are not only detected and diagnosed but also remediated and verified - all in real time. Attendees will walk away with a blueprint on how to unify DataOps, MLOps, and FinOps for their data pipelines.

sessions.t: Automating macOS at scale: AMI build, TCC, and provisioning on EC2 Mac
sessions.a: Automating macOS in the cloud brings challenges Linux and Windows don't. Going from a fresh EC2 Mac instance to a production-ready fleet means clearing non-obvious hurdles: building AMIs with EC2 Image Builder and Packer, pre-approving TCC permissions, bootstrapping Systems Manager, and working with Apple's security model. In this interactive chalk talk, we'll walk through the real friction points teams hit: image pipelines, the TCC dialog problem, remote access, MDM enrollment, and fleet provisioning. Bring your toughest macOS automation questions; most of the session is open Q&A.

sessions.t: Automating Serverless migrations at scale with AWS Transform
sessions.a: Runtime deprecations pile up. API migrations stall. Legacy code sits untouched because manual upgrades across hundreds of functions take weeks your team doesn't have. In this builders' session, use AWS Transform Custom to assess, plan, and execute Lambda runtime upgrades and API migrations at scale. Working hands-on, you'll run the full agentic loop: codebase assessment, transformation planning, incremental code changes committed to Git, and self-validating test execution. You'll scale transformations across hundreds of functions in parallel using AWS Batch and Fargate. Walk away with patterns for automated, large-scale modernization. Bring your laptop.

sessions.t: Autonomous AI Ops with AWS DevOps Agent and New Relic Autopilot (sponsored by New Relic)
sessions.a: Incident investigation still consumes 1-2 hours of engineering time per event. See how New Relic's Intelligent Observability Platform integrates with AWS DevOps Agent to: Autonomously triage incidents, pinpoint root cause, and deliver actionable remediation with no custom tooling required. Investigate incidents agentically correlating telemetry, code, and deployments across AWS, multi cloud, and on-prem environments. Demonstrate how this innovation proactively prevents future incidents by analyzing patterns and recommending improvements. Learn how customers are cutting MTTR by 75% and shifting from firefighting to prevention, and walk away ready to get started. This presentation is brought to you by New Relic, an AWS Partner.

sessions.t: Autonomous DBOps: Agentic AI for maintaining databases
sessions.a: Maintaining performance for Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS often requires manual effort, such as tuning queries, managing indexes, and handling alerts. In this builders' session, learn how to leverage agentic AI solutions implementing LLM-powered autonomous agents to monitor, diagnose, and optimize relational databases in real time. We will demonstrate how AI agents can analyze slow query logs, recommend or apply tuning actions, and trigger intelligent alerts using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Cloudwatch, AWS Lambda, and Amazon Systems Manager. Bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: Autonomous Multi-Agent system for Manufacturing: Live Demo with Kiro
sessions.a: To achieve the operational agility markets require, manufacturers are turning to AI agents that can reason and act autonomously across the product lifecycle. This session demonstrates how to rapidly build autonomous multi-agent systems using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Kiro that connect CMMS, MES, and ERP systems through Model Context Protocol (MCP). Watch a live demo where we use Kiro to develop specialized manufacturing agents that detect anomalies, diagnose root causes, and orchestrate corrective actions autonomously. Discover how Kiro's spec-driven development workflow compresses multi-agent system development from months to days. Leave with proven architecture patterns that you can apply to transform your production planning, supply chain optimization, and anomaly management processes.

sessions.t: Autonomous operations: reducing MTTR at scale, feat. BMG Bank
sessions.a: Operations teams face a growing volume of production incidents, but investigating root cause manually is slow and doesn't scale. At Banco BMG, one of Brazil's most established financial institutions with more than 9 million customers, roughly 350 operational events occurred daily, each investigation taking hours. In this lightning talk, see how AWS DevOps Agent began investigating these events autonomously, reducing root cause identification from hours to minutes. Learn to integrate the agent with your observability tools, correlate telemetry, logs, and code, and turn every investigation into compounding efficiency that lowers MTTR.

sessions.t: Autonomous Remediation with OpenTelemetry and DevOps Agent
sessions.a: You instrumented everything. You have metrics, logs, and traces. And when production breaks a human still has to piece it together, tab by tab, signal by signal, under pressure. That is not an observability problem, it’s an automation problem. We'll show you an architecture on AWS that closes it. OpenTelemetry captures signals across EKS, ECS, and Lambda. AWS DevOps Agent runs the investigation, finds the root cause, and prepares the fix. By the time a human looks at it, the pull request is ready. Come learn the triggers, investigation loop, and guardrails you need before letting an agent touch production.

sessions.t: Autonomous SRE: AWS DevOps Agent in Financial Services
sessions.a: In this session, learn how a large financial institution deploys AWS DevOps Agent as an autonomous SRE teammate to reduce incident investigation time from hours to minutes and free engineering teams from reactive firefighting. Explore the architecture spanning CloudWatch, Splunk, GitHub, and Slack integrations, and see how the agent correlates telemetry across data sources to identify root causes and generate mitigation plans. Walk away with practical patterns for deploying agentic operations in regulated, compliance-sensitive environments.

sessions.t: Autonomous Swarms, Human Command: Building Trusted AI Teammates on AWS
sessions.a: Simulate commanding autonomous drone fleets for search-and-rescue using Amazon Bedrock Agents, IoT Greengrass, and SageMaker. We demo a Human-Machine Teaming architecture where AI operates autonomously within trust boundaries, escalating to humans via configurable confidence thresholds.

sessions.t: Auto Scaling meets Capacity Reservations: Patterns that work
sessions.a: Capacity Reservations hold your instances. Auto Scaling right-sizes your fleet. Together, they give you both availability and cost efficiency. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard how to make them work seamlessly. We'll walk through strategies that keep reservation utilization high during scale-in, mixed-instance policies that balance cost and availability, and fallback patterns for Capacity Blocks transitions. Bring your scaling architecture and we'll work through it on the board.

sessions.t: AWS AI agents accelerate SAP migration and modernization on AWS
sessions.a: The legacy ERP system that once gave you a competitive edge may now be limiting your ability to innovate. Modernizing SAP can be complex, expensive, risky, and every delay is a missed opportunity to innovate. In this Chalk Talk, you will learn how AI Agents can make it possible to upgrade to SAP's Cloud ERP safely and cost-effectively in weeks, not months. Whether you're running SAP ECC, moving to RISE with SAP, modernizing ABAP and PI/PO, or migrating SAP Business Warehouse (BW), discover how AI-powered agents can take on the heavy lifting for you

sessions.t: AWS AI Factories: Bring production scale AI to your data center
sessions.a: Data sovereignty, data gravity, and latency requirements prevent many organizations from running all AI workloads in the public cloud. AWS AI Factories bring AWS and NVIDIA AI infrastructure directly into your data center, fully operated, maintained, and continuously updated by AWS. Run leading foundation models on premises for training and inference without building and managing AI infrastructure yourself or negotiating separate agreements with model providers. In this session, learn how organizations are accelerating AI adoption, reducing time to value, and maintaining full control of their data while benefiting from the AWS experience in their own facilities.

sessions.t: AWS AI from chips to agents: The end-to-end production AI foundation
sessions.a: The AI experiment is over. Now it has to work. This session walks through the AWS AI Platform end-to-end, starting at the chip layer with AWS Trainium and AWS Graviton delivering up to 40% better price performance. From there, model inference and customization through Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker AI. Then production agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Every layer co-designed so workloads move across the stack without rearchitecting. You will leave knowing which service handles which job, where the layers connect to accelerate production timelines, and how to keep your architecture open as your AI strategy evolves.

sessions.t: AWS AI League: Build agents with AgentCore (Agentic Football Cup)
sessions.a: Coordinating agents is where multi agent systems break. They duplicate work, drop handoffs, and burn tokens. In this workshop, build and deploy five autonomous agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore using Kiro and the Strands Agents SDK, then field them five versus five in live Agentic Football matches. Write the tools your agents call, orchestrate multi turn reasoning across a maze like arena, and solve coordination problems that decide the match. Tune prompts, roles, and tactics between rounds and watch your score climb a live leaderboard. Leave with working code, production ready multi agent patterns, and a shot at the Finale.

sessions.t: AWS AI League: Build domain specific AI with Forge
sessions.a: In this hands-on workshop you’ll compete head-to-head with other builders to build your own domain specific AI. You’ll tackle real-world challenges as you generate synthetic datasets, experiment with model customization, and fine-tune models to improve accuracy, clarity, and relevance. You’ll learn just how accessible and cost-effective AI customization can be. Whether you’re chasing the championship or simply sharpening your AI expertise, this session delivers practical techniques you can apply immediately. You must bring your laptop to participate

sessions.t: AWS AI League Championship Grand Finale: Agentic Football Cup
sessions.a: Experience the ultimate AI showdown from your theater seat as fifty finalists from the AWS AI League season battle head-to-head in real time for the $50,000 championship prize. This electrifying viewing experience offers ML practitioners, developers, and AI enthusiasts unique insights into agent orchestration, model customization, and multi-agent coordination at scale, as five-versus-five AI agent squads face off live in Agentic Football, built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and the Strands Agents SDK.

sessions.t: AWS AI League: Train with RLVR on SageMaker, deploy in AgentCore
sessions.a: Turn a generic model into one that wins on your task, and prove it with data. In this hands-on workshop, you customize a foundation model on Amazon SageMaker AI using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), with no infrastructure to manage. Then you build an agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that orchestrates the model end to end: preparing datasets, triggering training, registering models, evaluating with LLM-as-a-Judge, and deploying to a real-time endpoint. Your score posts to a live leaderboard, and you tune between rounds to climb it. You walk away knowing when customization beats a strong prompt.

sessions.t: AWS Backup at scale: centralizing enterprise data protection
sessions.a: Protecting a single workload is straightforward. But when every team owns their own accounts, organizations need a centralized approach to enforce consistent data protection across all of them. We'll dig into how to build backup architectures that scale across your entire AWS estate, covering Organizations backup policies to enforce protection standards across accounts, cross-account and cross-region copy strategies, and Backup Audit Manager for compliance monitoring and audit evidence. Whether you're onboarding new accounts or tightening controls on existing ones, we'll walk through patterns for centralized data protection you can prove.

sessions.t: AWS Backup: Centralized data protection for your cloud environment
sessions.a: Managing data protection across a growing cloud environment requires a centralized strategy. AWS Backup was designed around this principle, giving more than 150,000 organizations a fully managed service to automate backup operations, enforce protection policies at scale, and safeguard 20+ AWS services from a single console. From human error to infrastructure failures to targeted attacks, AWS Backup helps ensure you can recover the right data, at the right time, with confidence. In this session, learn how AWS Backup works, how you can use it to protect mission-critical workloads, and hear directly from customers about their implementation strategies and operational outcomes.

sessions.t: AWS Backup clean room recovery: Comprehensive resilience framework
sessions.a: Having an isolated vault is only half the battle. When a cyber event hits, you need confidence your backups are clean and recoverable. In this chalk talk, learn how to design an Isolated Recovery Environment using AWS Backup that validates and restores data in a secure space separate from production: reducing blast radius, breaking the kill chain, and proving recoverability on demand. We'll cover immutable air-gapped copies, automated restore testing with malware scanning, and Multi-party approval to control recovery access during account compromise. Leave with a framework for building recovery confidence into your backup strategy.

sessions.t: AWS CDK - Contributing AI safety tooling to the IaC ecosystem
sessions.a: AI agents generate infrastructure-as-code that looks correct but fails 38% of the time at deployment. The open source Agent Toolkit for AWS provides skills for validation, linting, and security checks that any MCP-compatible AI tool can consume before deploying. This chalk talk covers how we contributed these capabilities as open source tooling that works across cfn-lint, Checkov, and cdk-nag, improving first-deploy success from 62% to 82%. Attendees discuss how to build similar validation layers for their own IaC tools and the tradeoffs between blocking vs advisory checks in agent workflows.

sessions.t: AWS Certification & Proficiency Path: How to be Proficient in the Age of AI Agents?
sessions.a: Skills decay at unprecedented speed as AI reshapes what proficiency means. Certifications still validate expertise, but practitioners now need to demonstrate they can design, build, and optimize AI-powered systems alongside traditional cloud architecture. This lightning talk explains how AWS Training and Certification developed exam content, hands-on labs, and simulation-based assessments for agentic AI domains. You will also see how our team validated new competency frameworks, mapped learning paths to job roles, and built assessment experiences that measure real-world readiness rather than knowledge recall alone.

sessions.t: AWS detection and response innovations: security at machine speed
sessions.a: Discover how the latest AWS detection and response capabilities can help secure your environment more effectively - and faster than ever. We'll cover enhanced threat detection, automated vulnerability management, and how AI-powered security operations can close the gap between finding a risk and resolving it. Walk away with actionable insights for integrating AWS security services to strengthen and simplify security across your multicloud environment.

sessions.t: AWS Escape Room: Exam Prep for AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate
sessions.a: Prepare for AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate by playing this 3D virtual escape room game. Enter a 3D virtual environment, select your avatar, and navigate rooms locked behind AWS Solutions Architect Associate challenges and design your way out. Build VPCs, select storage and database services, configure high availability, and implement fault-tolerant architectures while solving exam-aligned puzzles and completing hands-on labs. Each room builds on the previous, testing progressively deeper architectural knowledge. Collaborate with peers or compete solo and escape first to claim the leaderboard.

sessions.t: AWS Escape Room: Exam Prep for AWS Certified AI Practitioner
sessions.a: Prepare for AWS Certified AI Practitioner by playing this 3D virtual escape room game where Certification prep meets competitive gaming. Generative AI knowledge unlocks doors here. Enter a narrative-driven 3D world, choose your avatar, and tackle progressively harder puzzles tied to AWS Certified AI Practitioner exam domains. Each locked room blends exam-style questions with hands-on labs covering foundation models, responsible AI, prompt engineering, and agentic workflows. Collaborate with teammates, solve challenges under time pressure, and race to escape before your peers to top the leaderboard.

sessions.t: AWS Escape Room: Exam Prep for AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
sessions.a: Prepare for AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner by playing this 3D virtual escape room game where Certification prep meets competitive gaming. Step into a 3D virtual world, choose your avatar, and race other players through rooms locked behind AWS Cloud Practitioner exam-style challenges. Each room combines interactive puzzles with hands-on labs that reinforce foundational cloud concepts like Compute, Storage, Networking, Security, and pricing models. Solve challenges collaboratively or compete solo, unlock rooms, and escape first to claim the leaderboard.

sessions.t: AWS fundamentals for the accidental SQL Server database administrator
sessions.a: You became a DBA, and now someone's asking you to be a cloud architect too. With over 240 AWS services, knowing where to start is half the battle. In this chalk talk, we'll map your core DBA tasks to AWS equivalents, covering networking, security, high availability, and disaster recovery for SQL Server. We'll also explore how AI-powered tools like Kiro and AWS Transform can accelerate your ramp-up, from intelligent code generation to modernizing .NET and SQL Server workloads. You'll leave with a clear path to choosing, securing, and cost-optimizing the right services. Come with questions.

Leverage Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock Agentcore, foundation models, AI agents, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and ML pipeline monitoring as you build and operate AI workloads end-to-end. Face challenges demanding both engineering excellence and operational awareness for AI systems in production! Whether you're an experienced ML engineer or just starting to build with AI, this GameDay will put your skills to the ultimate test. Come solo or bring a group. Either way, you'll compete on a team. sessions.t: AWS Glue Data Catalog: Govern data and AI agents with lineage and business context
sessions.a: AI agents generate SQL, surface insights, and take action on your data. Without governance guardrails, they hallucinate column meanings, query stale tables, and return wrong answers with high confidence. In this session, learn how to ground your AI agents in trusted metadata using AWS Glue Data Catalog. See how to flow business context like glossary terms, descriptions, and quality scores into agent workflows so they generate accurate, schema-aware queries instead of guessing. Walk away with practical patterns for governing AI-assisted analytics the same way you govern human analysts

sessions.t: AWS infrastructure as code: A year in review
sessions.a: Your infrastructure code deserves the same developer experience as your application code. This session recaps what's new for AWS CloudFormation and the AWS CDK: early change-set validation, the CloudFormation Language Server for your IDE, Stack Refactoring without downtime, drift-aware change sets, CDK Mixins for composable abstractions, cross-account output references, and the CDK Toolkit Library. See how these capabilities shorten your dev-test cycle and strengthen deployment safety.

Ready to dive deep into AWS? Join our All-In Session featuring hands-on environments where you'll tackle AI-powered solutions, DevOps automation, and cloud security scenarios. sessions.t: AWS Marketplace checkout, your website, your brand
sessions.a: When a buyer on your website is ready to purchase, AWS Marketplace gives them a procurement path their company has already approved. AWS Marketplace Storefront brings that path onto your own domain, so you keep your brand, your journey, and your sales team's visibility. In this chalk talk we'll build one live: catalog selection, buyer routing, embedding on your domain, and wiring requests into your CRM.

sessions.t: AWS migration agents fast-tracking SAP modernization
sessions.a: AI agents built on AWS are fast-tracking SAP migration and modernization from months to days. Learn from our marquee customers how they are deploying agentic fleets on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore spanning SAP landscape, auto-resolving complex workflows same-day that previously took days across multiple teams, saving thousands of hours and millions in operational costs. A reusable framework means each new agent inherits production-grade infrastructure from day one. In this session, learn how AI-powered migration agents de-risk ECC-to-S/4HANA transitions, accelerate RISE with SAP adoption, and modernize ABAP and BW workloads.

sessions.t: AWS Nitro System deep dive: Security, isolation, and innovation
sessions.a: The AWS Nitro System underpins every modern Amazon EC2 instance — purpose-built hardware and firmware delivering security, performance, and continuous innovation. In this deep dive, explore the Nitro architecture from custom silicon and modular design to networking and storage offload. Learn how the sixth-generation Nitro System introduces the AWS Nitro Isolation Engine, bringing formal verification to cloud isolation and extends Nitro-level isolation to containers. Discover how Nitro enables enhanced networking and confidential computing.

sessions.t: AWSome Automation: From Project Brief Prompt to Landing Page (sponsored by Storyblok)
sessions.a: Building a product-launch agent means solving several problems at once: assembling content from approved components, enforcing brand guidelines, localizing across markets, and ensuring a human has final say before anything reaches production. This session examines how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime and Storyblok handle each of those concerns without requiring a separate governance layer. Explore why a custom Strands agent made more sense than the no-code harness, how Cedar policies, Storyblok's component whitelist, brand guidelines, and publishing workflows form complementary guardrail layers, and how the architecture takes a brief to a reviewed, localized landing page in minutes. This presentation is brought to you by Storyblok, an AWS Partner.

sessions.t: AWS Outposts at scale: Amazon Robotics fulfillment
sessions.a: Amazon Robotics operates AWS Outposts across hundreds of fulfillment centers, each supporting multiple teams with distinct workload requirements. In this code talk, learn how the team architects isolation on shared Outposts infrastructure, manages resource quotas across competing workloads, and implements high-availability strategies that keep robotic systems running through hardware and network failures. We walk through the team onboarding model, failover patterns between Outposts and the parent Region, and monitoring strategies that detect degradation before it impacts fulfillment operations. Leave with reproducible patterns for running shared Outposts at scale.

sessions.t: AWS Partner: Agentic AI workflows for business users on Amazon Quick
sessions.a: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. Walk through a hands-on business scenario using Amazon Quick, the agentic AI workspace that connects to your tools and learns your workflows. Create knowledge spaces, run deep-research agents, connect external APIs, automate multi-step processes with Flows, and build a custom AI agent in a browser. Leave able to help customers put agentic AI to work across their teams and business applications. You must bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: AWS Partner: Build AI workflows that laugh in the face of disruption
sessions.a: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. AI workflows fail in ways that don't show up until production: a human misses the deadline, an external system says no, a sub-workflow loses state mid-flight. Fix it. Combine Step Functions, Lambda durable functions, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore into a three-layer stack that routes decisions, checkpoints execution, and reasons through uncertainty. Run real scenarios through the Simulator Panel and trace every layer live. Leave ready to build AI workflows that laugh in the face of disruption. You must bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: AWS Partner: Build the AgentCore agent your demo pretends to be
sessions.a: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. A good prompt gets you a chatbot. Everything else on AgentCore turns it into an agent. Build a customer support agent from scratch and progressively add persistent memory so it stops forgetting, tools through Gateway to reach real data, and Cedar policies that enforce boundaries, plus production traces, quality evaluations, and AI-driven optimization with A/B testing. Leave with hands-on experience on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and ready to show customers what separates a chatbot from an agent worth paying for. You must bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: AWS Partner: Govern AI agents by hacking one first
sessions.a: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. Exploit a live AI agent with a prompt injection attack that approves a fraudulent transaction, then defend it. Fix it with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails to block prompt attacks and PII leaks. Verify it: prove your controls are in place with AWS Config conformance packs and find ungoverned AI resources with Resource Explorer. Observe it: trace agent decisions and guardrail interventions in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Leave ready to assess a customer's AI agents for governance gaps, protect them, and prove the controls work. You must bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: AWS Partner: Ship an AI agent without crossing your fingers
sessions.a: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. AI agents work great in demos but break in production. Replace luck with observability. Prototype a role-based agent with the Strands SDK. Evaluate it with custom evaluators for quality and compliance. Deploy it to production on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Observe it with OpenTelemetry tracing and CloudWatch dashboards. Detect drift by evaluating production traffic at scale. Leave ready to take a customer's AI agent from prototype to production-grade. You must bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: AWS Partner: Your agent can wait. Go fix the app it depends on.
sessions.a: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. An agent is only as reliable as the services it calls. Before you fix anything, you need to know exactly what's broken. In this workshop you stress-test that claim — probing a service for gaps that break autonomous invocation, reading the findings against your own predictions, and making the call on what gets fixed first. Leave with a ranked fix list and a method that transfers to any service. You must bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: AWS Security Incident Response Challenge: Defend the Cake
sessions.a: The Magic Unicorn Cake recipe needs defending, and the Grumpy Cats are on the move. In this hands-on workshop, you become an AWS Security Engineer protecting critical assets. Working in teams, you strengthen security posture, establish continuous monitoring, and execute incident response playbooks while a live threat actor works to exfiltrate the recipe. A live leaderboard tracks every scored action. Through this immersive experience you learn threat modeling and the detection and response methodologies the team behind AWS Security Incident Response applies daily. Practical techniques that translate directly to your own environment. Bring your laptop.

sessions.t: AWS Serverless developer experience
sessions.a: The AWS Serverless Developer Experience (SDE) workshop is a hands-on workshop that immerses developers in building serverless solutions. It covers composing serverless applications, event-driven architecture principles, serverless observability, open-source tools, and deployment automation, and is available in Python, Typescript, Java, or .NET runtime. The workshop aims to accelerate your serverless maturity through a real-world use case, challenging you to understand the “why” behind the design decisions, and their implementation, as you complete the solution and apply Serverless best practices.

sessions.t: AWS Serverless developer experience
sessions.a: The AWS Serverless Developer Experience (SDE) workshop is a hands-on workshop that immerses developers in building serverless solutions. sessions.t: AWS Technical Essentials
sessions.a: AWS Technical Essentials gives you the foundation to start building on AWS with confidence. In this bootcamp, navigate the AWS Management Console, configure IAM security controls, deploy compute workloads across EC2, Lambda, and containers, set up databases with RDS and DynamoDB, manage storage with S3, explore networking services, and monitor resources with CloudWatch. Hands-on labs reinforce each topic, so you leave ready to design available, scalable, and cost-effective solutions.

sessions.t: AWS Transfer Family: From SFTP to Agentic AI Workflows
sessions.a: Learn how to build enterprise-grade file transfer solutions using AWS Transfer Family and extend them into agentic AI workflows. In this chalk talk, we'll walk through building secure SFTP servers, integrating with enterprise identity providers like Okta and Azure AD, and automating file processing using Terraform. We'll explore how event-driven architectures handle malware scanning with GuardDuty, and how AI agents via Amazon Bedrock AgentCore take over downstream tasks like data extraction and fraud detection. Bring your questions. You'll walk away with practical patterns for evolving traditional managed file transfer into intelligent, agentic processing pipelines.

sessions.t: AWS Transfer Family: From SFTP to Agentic AI Workflows
sessions.a: Learn how to build enterprise-grade file transfer solutions using AWS Transfer Family and extend them into agentic AI workflows. In this chalk talk, we'll walk through building secure SFTP servers, integrating with enterprise identity providers like Okta and Azure AD, and automating file processing using Terraform. We'll explore how event-driven architectures handle malware scanning with GuardDuty, and how AI agents via Amazon Bedrock AgentCore take over downstream tasks like data extraction and fraud detection. sessions.t: AWS wherever you need it: From the cloud to the edge
sessions.a: While most workloads can be migrated to the cloud, some remain on-premises or at the edge due to low latency, local data processing, or data residency needs. AWS services like AWS Local Zones, AWS Outposts, AWS Dedicated Local Zones, and AWS AI Factories extend AWS infrastructure, services, APIs, and tools wherever you need them, from metro areas to on-premises data centers and the far edge. Explore how these infrastructure services power a broad range of hybrid cloud and edge computing use cases such as financial trading, real-time threat detection, robotic control, and local processing of personally identifiable information (PII). Learn how AWS can help you meet digital sovereignty needs, run generative AI applications with on-premises and edge data, and accelerate migration and modernization with on-premises dependencies.

sessions.t: Balancing trust and agility - payment cryptography in the cloud with Capital One
sessions.a: How can we trust AWS with our payment keys? Join AWS payment security specialists and Capital One as they discuss controls and compliance for cloud-based payment cryptography. Learn how AWS built trust through transparency, sharing security architecture through public documents and regularly validating compliance through third party assessments. Takeaway how this allows Capital One to focus on application level security and payment innovation while letting AWS manage the security of the platform.

sessions.t: Become an AWS AI Business Strategist
sessions.a: Turning an AI idea into enterprise reality requires more than technical knowledge. In this bootcamp, you apply the Discover, Design, Deliver framework to diagnose business problems, assess organizational readiness, and scope AI pilots with clear success criteria. You navigate responsible AI tradeoffs, lead change management across cross-functional teams, evaluate agentic AI architectures for autonomy versus control, and build phased scaling strategies from proof of concept through production deployment.

sessions.t: Behind the Scenes: Building the Telecom Concierge
sessions.a: Whether you caught the demo on the expo floor, or you are enhancing your customer service systems with AI, this chalk talk dives into the architectural decisions powering a hyper-personalized customer experience. Explore the intelligent routing and retrieval trade-offs, and understand the business model implications when operators can shrink their physical footprint without degrading experience. Leave with a reference framework for designing context-aware systems at scale, a decision matrix for your retail strategy, and clarity on the ROI drivers so you can architect similar solutions in your network.

sessions.t: Benchmarking Bedrock knowledge bases for agents in production (sponsored by Braintrust)
sessions.a: In this talk, we’ll walk through an independent eval of Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, which manages the ingestion, parsing, and retrieval steps in a RAG application. In the first half, we’ll cover our methodology, including how we developed a dataset that queries documents such as tickets, wiki pages, and product docs, and what we decided to score: latency, cost, relevance, and citation support. We’ll also cover how we analyzed the results with research rigor, including p50 and p95 latency and confidence intervals around our metrics. In the second half, we’ll expand this into a conceptual understanding of evals and observability: why they’re important, how other companies are implementing them in production, and the terminology you need to know. This presentation is brought to you by Braintrust, an AWS Partner.

sessions.t: Best path forward: Rehost & replatform to containers with AWS Transform
sessions.a: Not every app needs the same migration path, and figuring out which ones to rehost versus containerize is where teams get stuck. In this workshop, you'll use AWS Transform to plan a combined migration and modernization across your application portfolio, then execute a mix of container and rehost migrations deploying to Amazon ECS or EKS. You'll work through the full lifecycle. Learn how to order waves and coordinate cutover across a mixed portfolio. Leave with a realistic multi-wave plan you can apply to your own environment. Laptop required.

sessions.t: Best path forward: Rehost & replatform to containers with AWS Transform
sessions.a: Not every app needs the same migration path, and figuring out which ones to rehost versus containerize is where teams get stuck. sessions.t: Best Practice Security Policies for Firewall Management
sessions.a: Firewall policy has evolved far beyond the basic ACLs of the last century. Creating comprehensible policy elements that scale your team's ability to keep workloads secure means a new policy management paradigm is needed. You have unique workloads coming online with new tech stacks as well as legacy systems still running windows. Some must comply with financial regulations, while others face privacy controls. This session will discuss how new firewall management features will help you avoid policy sprawl, save you time, effort, and of course ace that security audit.

sessions.t: Best practices for agentic-driven operations
sessions.a: AI agents are moving from assistants to operators, but how do they actually work within your operational workflows? Understand the architecture of agents that detect anomalies, diagnose root cause across distributed systems, and execute remediation like rollbacks, scaling, and traffic shifts. Learn how agents reason over telemetry, sequence actions, and determine when to escalate. Explore best practices for shaping agent behavior through guardrails, approval gates, and feedback loops as core design elements. Leave with a framework for evaluating where agents should act autonomously versus where human judgment remains essential.

sessions.t: Best practices for AI powered software development on Amazon Bedrock
sessions.a: You already have a preferred coding agent for software development. That agent touches your codebase, your infrastructure, and your production environment, and it needs guardrails, permissions, and rules to operate safely. In this workshop you connect an agent of your choice, such as Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, to Amazon Bedrock and deliver a real application from brief to production. You define specs the agent can act on, wire in automated test gates, apply Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, and lock down permissions before anything reaches infrastructure. Leave with a working app and a repeatable architecture you can adopt immediately. Laptop required.

sessions.t: Best practices for building an observability strategy in the age of AI
sessions.a: Most observability strategies were built for a pre-AI world and are no longer enough. Your data foundation remains critical, but the way you use that data is changing fast. In this chalk talk, we explore what stays the same, what must evolve, and what's new as AI reshapes observability. We'll cover the shift from static dashboards to dynamic experiences, from reactive alarms to AI-driven insights, and the new questions you need to answer, like how well your agents are performing. Join us as we share what AWS is learning as we embrace AI-led observability.

sessions.t: Best practices for building an observability strategy
sessions.a: Many teams buy tools before they agree on what they actually need to observe, ending up with multiple dashboards and unnecessary alerts. Learn what to instrument, what deserves an alert, how to set SLOs tied to real user experience, and how to keep the noise down as you grow. We will talk through the operating model decisions that make or break observability, such as who owns the tool, who pays for it, and how on-call actually works. Get a strategy framework and maturity checklist you can bring back to your leadership and engineering teams.

sessions.t: Best practices for cost optimization with AWS Backup
sessions.a: AWS Backup protects workloads across more than 20 AWS services, and each resource type brings its own cost profile. In this chalk talk, learn practical approaches to managing your data protection TCO by tailoring your AWS Backup strategy to each workload. We'll dig into full versus incremental backups, lifecycle policies, cold storage tiering for S3 and other resource types, and backing up direclty to logically-air-gapped-vault to protect data from ransomware without maintaining multiple copies. Then we'll cover how to build cost observability using AWS Backup reporting and monitoring to track and optimize spend.

sessions.t: Best practices for making coding agent orchestration more deterministic
sessions.a: As agents work on longer, more complex tasks, the context window fills up and the agent can lose track of its plan and execution steps. The manual setup required to get multi-agent orchestration to reliably complete these kinds of tasks can be complex and brittle. In this chalk talk, we will walk through best practices, tools, and patterns that power users have perfected to set up and scale multi-agent workloads. Bring questions, challenges, or edge cases you ran into and we'll walk you through how to approach them to improve reliability.

sessions.t: Best Practices for .NET modernization with AWS Transform
sessions.a: As organizations look to reduce tech debt for their .NET applications, builders are looking to accelerate modernization with AI tools. In this hands-on session, we'll explore best practices for modernizing .NET Framework applications with AWS Transform. You'll learn how to work alongside the agent to reach a desired outcome. Together, we will apply plan customizations, steering documents, checkpoints, and iteration. Come ready to share your use cases and leave with practical steps to efficient, cost-effective modernization. Bring your laptop with Visual Studio and an AWS account onboarded to AWS Transform.

sessions.t: Best practices for operating an Apache Iceberg lakehouse at scale
sessions.a: Operating an Iceberg lakehouse at scale means taming the operational overhead that grows with your data. In this chalk talk, we dive into table maintenance strategies—compaction, snapshot expiration, and orphan file cleanup—and discuss how Amazon S3 Tables automates these tasks. We'll whiteboard patterns for metadata management with AWS Glue Data Catalog, storage cost optimization through lifecycle-aware file pruning, and partition evolution without rewriting data. You will leave with battle-tested operational patterns for production Iceberg workloads.

sessions.t: Best practices for scaling self-managed GPU workstations
sessions.a: Artists, engineers, and scientists need GPU-powered virtual workstations, but managing VDI at scale means navigating instance selection, capacity, and cost. In this chalk talk, learn how to match EC2 G instances to user personas, from fractional GPU for task workers to full GPU for power users running 3D modeling, compositing, or subsurface visualization. Explore the decision framework covering instance types, DCV streaming, storage, security, and fleet orchestration with Research and Engineering Studio (RES). Whether supporting a VFX render farm's artist desktops, an oil company's subsurface workstations, or an automotive design studio, leave with guidance balancing performance, cost, and simplicity.

sessions.t: Best Practices for Successful Multiplayer Game Launches
sessions.a: The session covers best practices, architectural guidance and lessons learned for successful multiplayer game launches at scale. It's based on experience from helping hundreds of game customers from indie studios to AAA titles launch their games on AWS.

sessions.t: Best Practices for Successful Multiplayer Game Launches
sessions.a: The session covers best practices, architectural guidance and lessons learned for successful multiplayer game launches at scale. It's based on experience from helping hundreds of game customers from indie studios to AAA titles launch their games on AWS.

sessions.t: Best practices to build, connect and optimize agents on AgentCore
sessions.a: Ship agents fast. Connect to anything. Optimize continuously. In this session, learn best practices for the full agent lifecycle on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Build: go from local to production with microVM isolation, persistent memory, and any framework. Connect: access MCP servers, knowledge bases, and APIs through Gateway with automatic authentication. Optimize: trace every model call with OpenTelemetry-compatible observability and run continuous evaluations. Walk away with architectural patterns and implementation strategies to ship your first agent in minutes, not months.

sessions.t: Better, faster, cheaper: How Valkey is revolutionizing caching
sessions.a: Discover how the powerful combination of open source Valkey and Amazon ElastiCache is transforming the landscape of distributed caching. In this session, explore recent innovations including advanced search capabilities such as full-text search, a memory-efficient dictionary that reduces memory usage by up to 40%, and a multi-threaded architecture that enables instantaneous scaling by up to 230%. Learn about the infrastructure that enables ElastiCache to patch hundreds of thousands of customers while maintaining high availability, even for extreme workloads like Prime Day's trillion requests per minute.

sessions.t: Beyond AIOps: An operational model for the age of agent sprawl
sessions.a: As organisations move from a small number of AI assistants to a distributed ecosystem of agents that can discover tools, make decisions, and act, operational excellence must evolve. Drawing on HMRC’s work to develop a governed platform model for agentic systems, this session explores a practical maturity model spanning inventory, ownership, identity, delegated authority, observability, blast-radius controls, evaluation, and human accountability. Learn how existing platform engineering, SRE, security and service-management practices can be extended across cloud and SaaS ecosystems without creating a separate governance regime for every agent or vendor. Designed for platform leaders, SREs and architects preparing to scale agents safely in complex, regulated environments.

sessions.t: Beyond Batch: Modernize with Event-Driven Architecture & Serverless
sessions.a: In this builders' session, transform a batch-oriented data processing pipeline into a real-time, event-driven architecture using Amazon EventBridge, AWS Lambda, and AWS Step Functions. Working hands-on in small groups, you'll decompose a monolithic batch process into discrete event-driven steps, implement file-processing triggers, and design fan-out patterns for parallel execution. Learn when to keep batch and when to go event-driven, and leave with a working modernization pattern. You must bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: Beyond Benchmarks: Evaluating AI Safety with Formal Guarantees
sessions.a: As AI systems become increasingly capable and autonomous, safety evaluation is emerging as a critical challenge. While current evaluations largely rely on benchmark performance and empirical red-teaming, these approaches provide limited guarantees about real-world risk. This talk will explore an emerging direction in AI safety: evaluating model behavior with formal statistical guarantees. We will discuss how ideas from reliability engineering, robustness certification, and risk assessment can be applied to quantify catastrophic failure probabilities, the assumptions behind such guarantees, and their implications for deploying and governing frontier AI systems. This topic is highly relevant to the future of trustworthy and accountable AI.

sessions.t: Beyond chatbots: Event-driven AI agents on Apache Flink
sessions.a: Most AI agents wait for a prompt. Apache Flink Agents flips that—agents react autonomously to live event streams as Flink operators, with exactly-once guarantees, durable state, and millisecond latency. Learn how this event-driven foundation differs from request-response frameworks, then see an ops agent detect a failing Flink job, diagnose it with an LLM on Amazon Bedrock, retrieve a runbook, and remediate—no human in the loop. Hear from Flink committers on production agents at Alibaba and LinkedIn, and from AWS contributors building Bedrock and other AWS integrations upstream.

sessions.t: Beyond code generation: accelerating the entire SDLC on AWS
sessions.a: Teams pour AI into code generation and wonder why they're not shipping faster. In reality, accelerating one stage just moves the bottleneck downstream. This session follows a single task across its entire lifecycle and shows where AI compounds. We'll design and build with Kiro, pay down tech debt with AWS Transform, catch vulnerabilities early with AWS Continuum (formerly known as AWS Security Agent), ship through safe CI/CD pipelines, and resolve production issues with AWS DevOps Agent—then feed what we learn back into the next task. Come see our vision for an SDLC where every stage moves at the same speed.

sessions.t: Beyond English: Architecture Patterns for Multilingual AI Voice Agents
sessions.a: Deploying AI voice agents beyond English introduces unique challenges: accent handling, language detection, code-switching between languages mid-conversation, and cultural nuances in conversation flow. In this chalk talk, we share architecture patterns for building multilingual voice agents using Amazon Connect Agentic Voice. We cover real-world scenarios from deployments like Spanish and English coexistence, German with regional dialects, and Italian conversational AI. We discuss when speech-to-speech models work natively, when to fall back to TTS pipelines, how to handle polyglot but non-native accent scenarios, and practical approaches to knowledge base localization. Bring your language challenge and we'll design your multilingual architecture on the whiteboard.

sessions.t: Beyond Evals: Setting up your agents and your enterprise for success (sponsored by LangChain)
sessions.a: We are witnessing models and agents continually becoming more capable, all while the process of meaningfully evaluating them continues to be a challenge. In this session, we will dissect eval best practices observed both in the field and internally at LangChain. This session will go beyond just your technical evaluation toolkit and provide practical organizational and process takeaways and a better understanding of what future capabilities are unlocked downstream of good evaluation. This session will be especially relevant to teams deploying agents in cross-functional domains. This presentation is brought to you by LangChain, an AWS Partner.

sessions.t: Beyond fine-tuning: RL for reasoning agents with AWS Trainium
sessions.a: Supervised fine-tuning enables your model to follow instructions, but teaching it to reason requires reinforcement learning. RL workflows demand iterative loops that multiply compute costs — making AWS Trainium's purpose-built price performance critical. In this chalk talk, we explore what techniques like RLHF and GRPO bring to the table and how to run them on Trainium with the AWS Neuron software stack, Torchtitan, HuggingFace TRL, vLLM, and native PyTorch. We compare co-located vs. disaggregated RL architectures. You'll leave ready to implement cost-effective RL loops that train agents to reason.

sessions.t: Beyond fine-tuning: RL for reasoning agents with AWS Trainium

We compare co-located vs. disaggregated RL architectures. You'll leave ready to implement cost-effective RL loops that train agents to reason.

sessions.t: Beyond pilots: agentic AI transforming mortgage operations and IT at scale (sponsored by Tata Consultancy Services)
sessions.a: Mortgage lending still runs on handoffs, exceptions, and manual review. See how a leading US mortgage lender is rebuilding origination and servicing with agentic AI on AWS, cutting cycle times while keeping controls and auditability intact. We will also show how the same agent patterns reach IT operations, resolving incidents before customers feel them. Tata Consultancy Services shares the reference architecture, guardrails, and adoption model behind both. Built for financial services business and operations leaders, CIOs and IT operations heads, and data and AI leaders, this session gives you a practical path from promising pilots to production at enterprise scale. This presentation is brought to you by Tata Consultancy Services, an AWS Partner.

sessions.t: Beyond Prompt Engineering: Optimize the Agent Harness
sessions.a: An agent’s performance depends on far more than its model or system prompt. Tools, instructions, context management, memory, orchestration, and runtime policies form an agent harness that can determine whether the same model succeeds or fails. This session introduces harness optimization: a systematic, evaluation-driven approach to improving the complete agent system. Learn how to identify high-leverage changes, design controlled experiments, optimize for quality, latency, and cost, and avoid overfitting to benchmarks. Leave with a repeatable method for turning agent development into an engineering discipline.

sessions.t: Beyond RSA: Post-quantum data encryption using ML-KEM in AWS KMS
sessions.a: RSA and Elliptic Curve Cryptography secure nearly every application today, and both are vulnerable to future cryptographically relevant quantum computers. Data captured now can be decrypted later, so applications needing long-term confidentiality should adopt post-quantum encryption well before those computers arrive. AWS KMS now offers ML-KEM, the NIST-standardized replacement for RSA and ECDH key establishment and ultimately encryption under asymmetric keys. It protects the private keys in FIPS 140-3 Level 3 HSMs. In this session, learn about ML-KEM and how to use it as a building block for quantum-safe encryption using Hybrid Public Key Encryption (HPKE).

sessions.t: Beyond the Build: Scaling and Governing AI Agents with Dataiku and Amazon Bedrock (sponsored by Dataiku)
sessions.a: As enterprises move from experimenting with AI agents to deploying them at scale, the challenge is no longer just how to build agents, it’s how to maintain visibility, performance, and control across the growing agent ecosystem. This session will explore how Amazon Bedrock and Dataiku Agent Management support the agent lifecycle from creation through enterprise-wide management. Attendees will see how organizations can build and deploy agents with AWS while using Dataiku to discover agents, monitor performance, and identify risk across environments, helping teams scale agentic AI with greater confidence and governance. This presentation is brought to you by Dataiku, an AWS Partner.

sessions.t: Beyond the Buy Button: Cisco on AWS Marketplace, a Partner-Led AI Win (sponsored by Cisco)
sessions.a: AWS Marketplace isn't just a procurement channel, it's a financial lever. A typical ISV saves a procurement cycle. Cisco draws down committed spend against the infrastructure your agents run on: connectivity from cloud to edge, visibility into agent behavior, and protection for models, identities, and data. Partners add the expertise to deploy it right, turning a procurement decision into an architectural one, a true better together win with AWS. This presentation is brought to you by Cisco, an AWS Partner.

sessions.t: Beyond the Docs: Operating Scoped VPC Endpoints in Real Environments
sessions.a: Scoped VPC endpoint policies look simple, until production traffic proves otherwise. In this interactive chalk talk, we'll walk through real-world failures we've encountered while deploying account- and org-scoped endpoint policies and trace the identity flows, auth chains, and hidden dependencies behind them. Together, we'll explore a key lesson: endpoint policies evaluate the request that's actually made, not the request you think you're making. Bring your questions and experiences as we whiteboard the assumptions that lead to outages and learn how to spot them before they impact production.

sessions.t: Beyond the GPU count: Engineering inference at scale
sessions.a: You have enough GPUs in your server to cover your software requirements. But is that all you need to consider? In a world where everyone is fighting for GPUs, picking the wrong server type is one of the most expensive mistakes an engineering team makes at scale. This session shares lessons running GPU inference across AWS and bare metal connected privately. You'll see how EKS Hybrid Nodes provides a single scheduling plane, failure modes, and how to use AI to accelerate decisions without replacing engineering judgement. Leave with a cloud and bare metal architectural pattern and a GPU selection framework covering workload fit and server tradeoffs.

sessions.t: Beyond the GPU: Optimizing AI performance with storage architecture
sessions.a: When AI workloads need scale or speed, the instinct is to add more compute, but GPU speed only pays off when the data keeps pace. From training to inference, storage architecture shapes performance at every stage: optimizing checkpoints for uninterrupted training, reducing model load times, extending context windows beyond GPU memory, and accelerating retrieval for RAG and inference workloads. Learn how Amazon FSx for Lustre, FSx for OpenZFS, and Amazon S3 Express One Zone give you those levers.

sessions.t: Beyond the IDE: autonomous development with Kiro web and mobile
sessions.a: Kiro web and mobile bring agentic development to your browser—every session in an isolated cloud sandbox, no local setup, accessible anywhere you have an internet connection. In this hands-on workshop, you'll work with Kiro two ways. First, iterate interactively: connect a repo, explore the codebase, and shape changes in real time. Then go hands-off: assign a task from a tracked issue, let Kiro plan and implement autonomously, and review the pull request it opens. Sessions run in the cloud and keep going after you close your laptop—check in and review diffs from your phone with the Kiro iOS app. You must bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: Beyond the pilot: How customers scaled Kiro and proved the value
sessions.a: Adopting a coding agent is as much an organizational challenge as a technical one. In this panel, engineering leaders from companies that deployed Kiro at scale share what worked: rollout strategies that drove adoption, training approaches that met developers where they were, governance guardrails that satisfied security teams, and the metrics they use to measure productivity impact. Bring your questions—this is an open conversation about the patterns, pitfalls, and payoffs of making AI-assisted development the default across an engineering organization.

sessions.t: Beyond the simulator: Quantum chemistry workflows on real hardware
sessions.a: Get hands-on experience running quantum computing experiments using the Kvantify SDK; the same workflow used by researchers. In this workshop, participants will set up and execute computational workflows, testing them locally, on a classical simulator via Amazon Braket, and finally on a real quantum processing unit (QPU). Through practical exercises in enzyme engineering and battery development, learners will see how quantum computing accelerates discovery in life sciences and materials science, bridging the gap from simulation to real quantum hardware.

sessions.t: Booking.com's playbook for cloud transformation at global scale
sessions.a: Booking.com connects millions of travelers to over 28 million listings across 43 languages. Their cloud transformation had to match that scale. In this session, hear how Booking.com dissolved organizational silos, broke through bottlenecks, and compressed timelines to fundamentally change how they build, operate, and innovate. You'll learn the architectural decisions, migration frameworks, and repeatable patterns that scaled cloud adoption across the enterprise, and how embedding AI from the ground up now powers next-generation customer experiences. Leave with a playbook for turning cloud transformation into continuous, cloud-fluent competitive advantage.

sessions.t: Boost Apache Spark performance and reduce costs with AWS Analytics
sessions.a: Join this interactive chalk talk to explore best practices for building high-performing, cost-efficient Spark applications using AWS analytics data processing services. We'll discuss the AWS performance-optimized runtime for Apache Spark—delivering up to 4.5x faster execution across Amazon EMR, Amazon Athena, and AWS Glue—meaning faster jobs and lower compute spend. Explore flexible deployment models—long-running clusters, on-demand elasticity with EMR Serverless, Kubernetes integration with EMR on EKS, and Graviton instances for up to 30% cost reduction. We'll also highlight how Glue's auto scaling, Flex execution class, and Iceberg integrations simplify pipelines while optimizing costs.

sessions.t: Boost Performance: Salesforce, Slack and AWS Headless Connectivity (sponsored by Salesforce)
sessions.a: Disconnected systems slow teams down. See how Agentforce, Slack and AgentCore Bedrock enable your Headless agentic strategy to unlock seamless collaboration and boost productivity across teams in real time. This presentation is brought to you by Salesforce, an AWS Partner.

sessions.t: Bootstrapping GitOps on Amazon EKS with Argo CD, ACK, and kro
sessions.a: Deploying an application to Kubernetes is straightforward. Provisioning its AWS resources, IAM roles, policies, and supporting infrastructure is more complex. Separate infrastructure and application toolchains create fragmented workflows and increase the risk of drift. In this session, we'll build a GitOps platform using EKS Capabilities, Argo CD, AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK), and kro. See how kro packages Kubernetes workloads and their AWS dependencies behind a single, self-service custom resource. Learn how Argo CD continuously reconciles the entire application stack from one Git repository. Finally, watch several microservices deploy, with their cloud resources provisioned and continuously managed alongside their workloads.

sessions.t: Break free from on-premises NAS: Migrating to AWS
sessions.a: Learn how Amazon FSx storage simplifies the migration of on premises workloads to the cloud while keeping the compatibility and performance your apps depend on. With fully managed, block and file storage that eliminates operational overhead, see real-world migration patterns for user file shares, high-performance applications, enterprise databases like Oracle, SAP, and SQL Server, and VMware migration with AWS Transform and FSx for ONTAP. Discover how organizations are reducing costs and accelerating innovation.

sessions.t: Break free from Oracle licensing and modernize to Aurora PostgreSQL
sessions.a: Oracle modernization promises freedom from licensing, lock-in, and operational overhead, yet projects stall on PL/SQL packages, schema quirks, and application logic that resists automated translation. In this workshop, you'll migrate a live Oracle workload to open-source Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL end-to-end and tackle the hardest schema conversion challenges that derail real-world projects. You'll work through PL/SQL translation, dependency resolution, and validation using AWS agentic AI.

sessions.t: Breaking down batch inference with Ray Data on Amazon EKS
sessions.a: Batch inference is more than running a model over a large dataset. In this interactive chalk talk, we build an end-to-end batch inference architecture on Amazon EKS one component at a time. We examine when to use Spark with Ray Serve and when Ray Data can unify preprocessing and inference. Along the way, we address data sharding, storage and data movement, GPU scheduling, autoscaling, batch sizing, checkpointing, retries, observability, security, isolation, and cost. Attendees will leave with a practical decision framework and a production architecture for operating reliable, scalable batch inference with Ray Data and the KubeRay Operator.

sessions.t: Break it to prove It: Fault-isolated architecture built to recover
sessions.a: Your recovery plan is only as good as the architecture backing it. This workshop presents single-Region and multi-Region resilience patterns built along fault isolation boundaries, where failure scope dictates which recovery mechanism to engage. Using Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC), you architect for discrete blast radii, then validate each boundary through fault injection with AWS Fault Injection Service. Observability surfaces the failure, alarms classify scope, and automated recovery executes without intervention. The result: proof that your architecture recovers the way you designed it to. Bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: Breathing Life into Game Worlds with Amazon Neptune & GraphRAG
sessions.a: Static NPC dialogue can't unlock rich game worlds. This session shares a production pattern using Amazon Neptune, Bedrock GraphRAG, and the "Entity as Agent" approach. We live-demo natural-language character relationship search, in-character AI dialogue, and in-game party composition recommendations

sessions.t: Bridging clouds: Building global multicloud and hybrid networks on AWS
sessions.a: It's no secret, enterprises today run workloads across multiple clouds and on-premises data centers, but stitching together global connectivity without complexity remains a challenge. In this workshop, easily extend AWS connectivity to other clouds and on-premises environments using AWS Interconnect, AWS Direct Connect, and AWS Cloud WAN. Build a global multicloud network, then apply Amazon VPC Lattice to enforce security and handle overlapping IP address spaces without complex NAT configurations. Leave equipped to architect and deploy hybrid network architectures using modern application networking patterns. Bring your laptop.

sessions.t: Bringing better Amazon EC2 price performance to your pipeline with AWS Graviton
sessions.a: Which workload should move to AWS Graviton first? And what actually changes in your pipeline? In this code talk, we answer both live. We profile an application portfolio to find strong Arm64 candidates, check dependency and library compatibility, and update a working CI/CD pipeline to build multi-architecture container images for x86 and Arm64, so you see exactly what changes and why. Then we deploy the workload and run a side-by-side load test to compare price performance. You'll leave with a repeatable workload-selection checklist and pipeline patterns you can apply to your own AWS Graviton adoption with minimal disruption.

sessions.t: Bring Oracle Databases to AWS Without Starting Over (sponsored by Oracle)
sessions.a: Organizations want the flexibility and innovation of AWS, but they cannot afford to rearchitect the mission-critical Oracle Database applications their businesses depend on. This session explains how Oracle AI Database@AWS provides a simpler path from on-premises Oracle Exadata and RAC environments to AWS with minimal to no database or application changes. Explore how customers can maintain full database capabilities and architectural compatibility, connect Oracle data to AWS applications with low latency, and unify data with AWS analytics, machine learning, and agentic AI services. We will also examine the operational value of familiar AWS tools, collaborative support, integrated security, and simplified purchasing. Attendees will learn how migration can reduce infrastructure constraints while creating a stronger foundation for innovation across Oracle and AWS. This presentation is brought to you by Oracle, an AWS Partner.

sessions.t: Bring Your Own Ontology: Ground Amazon Quick in Enterprise Context
sessions.a: Enterprise questions rarely have answers in a single document. Your business runs on connections — customers to products, teams to processes, risks to regulations — but vector search doesn't see any of that. In this chalk talk, we show how to ground Amazon Quick in your enterprise context by integrating it with a knowledge graph built from your domain knowledge. We'll walk through how we built this pattern using GraphRAG for real customers and the results they achieved. Then we'll open the whiteboard — bring your toughest use case and we'll sketch your ontology live, showing how Quick would traverse it to deliver dramatically better answers.

sessions.t: Bring your S3 data to your compute with S3 Files
sessions.a: S3 Files makes the data in your S3 buckets available to your compute as a high-performance file system, so any POSIX-based tool or workload can work with S3 objects in place. We will work through the two ways customers use it: giving established file-based applications direct access to data already in S3, and giving agents and other short-lived compute a durable, isolated file workspace they can leave behind. We'll whiteboard the decisions that matter: connecting compute to S3 Files across VPCs, accounts, and on-prem; tuning for price and performance; and securing access with IAM, POSIX permissions, and encryption.

sessions.t: Bring your tech debt: build a custom transformation that fixes it
sessions.a: Every codebase has that annoying pattern: the deprecated internal library, the logging convention nobody follows, the framework migration that keeps getting deferred. In this small-group builder session, you'll tackle yours. Bring a real modernization problem from your own code and build a custom transformation in AWS Transform custom that solves it—defining the transformation in natural language, running it against a repository, and refining it until it holds up. No fixed curriculum and no slides: this is open-ended, hands-on time. Stuck for an idea? We'll have a few ready-made problems on hand. You must bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: British Airways: Agentic AI for Java modernization at 48% lower cost
sessions.a: You have hundreds of services stuck on aging infrastructure, and your engineers are spending more time maintaining them than building new experiences. British Airways faced the same challenge with 590 Github repositories and 200 business services on EC2. Using AWS Transform custom, they built an agentic AI platform that autonomously migrates services to ECS Fargate on Graviton, cutting costs by 48% without compromising business logic. They also extended it to improve test coverage and patch security vulnerabilities continuously. In this session, you'll learn how to build a repeatable transformation engine and give your engineers time back.

sessions.t: Build a backend before your coffee gets cold with AWS Blocks
sessions.a: What if you could stand up a full application backend—database, auth, real-time messaging, file storage, even an AI agent—in TypeScript, running locally, with no AWS account required? AWS Blocks is an open-source framework where each "Block" bundles your app code, a local dev implementation, and production AWS infrastructure. Compose the Blocks you need, run one command to develop locally, then deploy the same code to AWS unchanged. Built for a world where AI agents write the code, Blocks ships steering files that guide agents to correct architecture from the start. In this lightning talk, see how fast full-stack can be.

sessions.t: Build a brand knowledge graph for retail and CPG AI
sessions.a: Retail and CPG brands invest years building product expertise, from visual styling rules to ingredient pairing and formulation knowledge, that generic AI simply cannot replicate. In this builder session, you'll construct a Graph RAG solution that encodes brand-specific curatorial knowledge into an Amazon Neptune Analytics knowledge graph with multimodal vector embeddings. Using a CPG product catalog, you'll build graph schemas capturing formulation relationships, brand hierarchies, and cross-category pairing rules. Then see how vector similarity search combined with graph traversal enriches retrieval context before grounding Amazon Bedrock LLM responses. Leave with a working deployed architecture adaptable across retail and CPG.

sessions.t: Build a container pipeline that blocks tampered images at the gate
sessions.a: What if you want to prove cryptographically that every container in your environment is untampered and fully inventoried? In this builders' session, you build exactly that. Dive deep into the AWS Signer cryptographic model: KMS-backed keys, ECDSA P-256, COSE_Sign1 envelopes, and notation trust policies. Implement ECR managed signing, generate SBOMs with Amazon Inspector, slim images to reduce attack surface, and enforce admission on EKS with Kyverno. Then stress test it with attack simulations against the pipeline you just built.

sessions.t: Build a cost optimization playbook for your AI workload
sessions.a: Bring a representative prompt set from your own workload and optimize it live. In this builders session, you apply prompt caching, configure Intelligent Prompt Routing, and right-size model choice for the best price-performance, measuring token cost before and after each change. You see exactly which levers move the needle for your traffic and which do not. Leave with a cost optimization playbook tuned to what you run and the evidence to support each decision.

sessions.t: Build a cost-optimized multi-agent system on Amazon EC2 CPUs and GPU
sessions.a: In this hands-on workshop, you build a production-ready multi-agent system that splits workloads between CPU and GPU EC2 instances — the best of both worlds. Starting with an autonomous customer-support pipeline, you deploy reasoning agents on GPU and orchestration, tool-calling, and retrieval agents on CPUs. You profile each stage, measure latency and cost per agent call, and implement routing policies that dynamically assign tasks to the optimal compute tier. By the end, you have a hybrid deployment with a live cost dashboard showing 30–45% savings vs. GPU-only baselines.

sessions.t: Build a data-driven migration plan with AWS Transform
sessions.a: You're planning a data center exit and need leadership to say yes. That means persuasive data, realistic cost estimates, and a proposal that makes financial sense. In this builders' session, you'll use AWS Transform's agentic AI capabilities paired with Discovery Agent data to assess your existing environment, generate cost estimates, and build a compelling business case for migration. You'll work through the end-to-end workflow from discovery and analysis to financial modeling, and leave ready to present a data-driven migration proposal to your stakeholders.

sessions.t: Build a digital asset tokenization issuance solution
sessions.a: The emergence of digital assets and stablecoins requires bridging traditional message-based finance protocols such as SWIFT and ISO 20022 to programmable settlement rails while preserving institutional security, auditability, and governance. In this session, learn how to build a production-ready end-to-end hybrid settlement architecture on AWS that ingests financial messages, normalizes them into canonical settlement instructions, and executes tokenized asset transfers on-chain. Explore hardware-backed signing with AWS KMS, on-chain signer governance, and three settlement patterns: issuance, redemption, and transfer, with full audit trails, idempotent transaction handling, and EIP-712 typed signing. Bring your laptop to participate.

sessions.t: Build a fully managed data lake with Amazon S3 Tables
sessions.a: Data lakes have evolved from raw Parquet files with Hive-style partitioning to fully managed Apache Iceberg tables. In this hands-on workshop, you'll understand that evolution, then build a working analytics data lake with Amazon S3 Tables in under two hours. You'll create an S3 table bucket, ingest real-world data, migrate data into the bucket, and query it with Amazon Athena. You'll also learn how to connect third-party tools like DuckDB for interactive exploration. Along the way we’ll cover the benefits of fully managed Iceberg tables and when to use Amazon S3 Tables as the storage foundation for open data architectures.

sessions.a: Data lakes have evolved from raw Parquet files with Hive-style partitioning to fully managed Apache Iceberg tables. In this hands-on workshop, you'll understand that evolution, then build a working analytics data lake with Amazon S3 Tables in under two hours. You'll create an S3 table bucket, ingest real-world data, migrate data into the bucket, and query it with Amazon Athena. You'll also learn how to connect third-party tools like DuckDB for interactive exploration. Along the way we’ll cover the benefits of fully managed Iceberg tables and when to use Amazon S3 Tables as the storage foundation for open data architectures.

sessions.t: Build a fully managed open source observability stack on AWS
sessions.a: You want open standards without the operational burden of self-managing backends. In this code talk, we live-code a complete open source observability architecture: instrument a service with OpenTelemetry (auto and manual), configure the OTel Collector pipeline, and route metrics to Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus, logs and traces to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Walk through each integration decision from SDK selection to collector topology, and leave with a working, production-ready stack built entirely on open source standards with zero infrastructure to manage.
